top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A list of current employees is not posted.

top_violation_types.title: Post Notice of Permit Renewal (26 TAC §745.479)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The notice of the permit renewal was not posted. This was corrected at the inspection when the director printed and posted it.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection form was not posted.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were not complete.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children were observed watching mickey mouse during snack time    This was corrected during the inspection when I observed the caregiver turn off the tablet and closed it.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.
